title: scaffold_view
description: Read-only generation, writes nothing and never overwrites a file. Returns a bounded source patch for a new view of a type, an output-test template that FAILS on an assertion until the view is implemented, the registration or manifest change and the collection recipe. Apply the patch with your normal code editor. Next: edit, then collect.

maxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte budget of the whole serialized reply (design section 4).
